description: Mancha de Inundação is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Áreas de inundação potencial previstas para os períodos de retorno de 05, 25 e 100 anos. As áreas foram obtidas via modelagem hidráulica para a elaboração dos cadernos de drenagem do Plano Diretor de Drenagem bem como a partir do histórico de SIURB para as áreas ainda não modeladas. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Meio Físico, Desastres, Hidrografia, geoscientificInformation. The portal shows 2024-08-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
